fix_code:
N, K = map(int, input().split())
P = list(map(int, input().split()))

min_span = float('inf')

for i in range(N - K + 1):
    subsequence = P[i:i + K]
    if max(subsequence) - min(subsequence) == K - 1:
        min_span = min(min_span, i + K - 1 - i)

print(min_span)
